item.title: Kansas bill eliminates mail-in ballots if court strikes down signature verification law
item.description: A Senate bill would end advance voting by mail if a court strikes down state law requiring election officials to verify a voter’s signature. The prospect of such a ruling is playing out in Shawnee County. Continue reading ...
